summary: Delta fixes most prior findings, but late source activation, interrupted quality-pass recovery, and test-scope acceptance remain blocking.

findings.summary: Figma and image sources discovered during spec work still lack a required activation handoff.
findings.evidence: FR-005 requires a saved context for every UI design source. SKILL.md:92 activates a late source only when the spec role reports an activation prerequisite; spec-builder.md:20 requires that report for newly encountered Pen references, and line 44 covers text-only classification, but neither requires it for newly discovered Figma or image sources.
findings.fix: Require spec-builder to report late activation prerequisites for Figma and image sources, including source and scope, so the orchestrator persists context and resumes the same stage.

findings.summary: A crash after the last UI task is checked can strand the reserved quality pass without a recovery spawn.
findings.evidence: FR-024 and FR-028 require the quality pass and resume from saved context. The role checks and commits its last task before reserving or finishing ui_agent_pass; SKILL.md:119 selects fresh spans from unchecked tasks, while its same-range resume rule covers partial and relay returns, not a crash or run restart. With no unchecked UI task, an in-progress reservation or unstarted pass has no required recovery spawn.
findings.fix: Persist the final UI span and pending quality-pass phase before its last task can be considered complete. On restart, respawn that span to reconcile or finish the pass and checks before advancing, even when all UI boxes are checked.

findings.summary: Expanded test scope lacks evidence of explicit acceptance of the complete current seam-to-failure-path scope.
findings.evidence: ENG-4 and engineering.md's Confirmed test scope require fresh explicit acceptance of the complete scope after a failure-path expansion. The new Confirmed line claims Q2 accepted all seams and paths, but state.json records Q2 only as acceptance to add traversal and symlink-escape paths; the stored Q2 question contains only its ID.
findings.fix: Obtain and persist a protected confirmation naming every declared seam and its complete failure-path scope, or provide an immutable snapshot proving Q2 accepted that exact scope; update the Confirmed line to reference that evidence.
